name: Wait What
description: Stop. That last message did not land: re-pitch it.
longDescription: A one-line prompt invoked as `/wait-what` when the agent's last message did not land. It asks for a re-pitch: a little context first, sentences in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English (a controlled vocabulary with short, single-topic sentences), and terms taken from the repository's `CONTEXT.md` — following `CONTEXT-MAP.md` to the right one when a repo has more than one. Pairs with repos that keep a domain glossary; without a `CONTEXT.md` the vocabulary rule has nothing to draw on.
